gloss: Urasenke; the largest school of Japanese tea ceremony

definitions.gloss: Urasenke; the largest school of Japanese tea ceremony
definitions.explanation: The largest and most widely practiced of the three major schools of Japanese tea ceremony, descended from the Sen family through a branch line. Uses the reading ちゃどう for {茶道|ちゃどう} and maintains an extensive network of tea rooms and branch schools both in Japan and overseas.

examples.english: I attend an Urasenke tea ceremony class.

notes:
{裏千家|うらせんけ} is the largest and most widely taught of the three major schools of Japanese tea ceremony ({三千家|さんせんけ}), descended from the Sen family through a branch line.

CULTURAL NOTE:
{裏千家|うらせんけ} reads ⟦{茶道|ちゃどう}→茶道：05507_chadou⟧ as ちゃどう, unlike ⟦{表千家|おもてせんけ}→表千家：30917_omotesenke⟧, which reads it as さどう. Its extensive network of branch schools, in Japan and abroad, makes it the school non-Japanese learners are most likely to encounter.
